description: A governed MCP server for Zendesk, built by Cyan Eclipse Technologies over the platform's public REST API v2 shape — the largest support installed base has no official MCP server, and Haven is the BUILD-side answer. OAuth-first by construction: API-token auth is not implemented at all, because Zendesk's published sunset kills all API tokens on 2027-04-30; presenting one is refused by name. Reads are masked at egress; internal writes (tags, notes, fields) are T1; a public reply can only be sent as a draft plus an approval token bound to the draft's exact content hash; status/assignee changes are likewise token-gated; deletes, merges, bulk updates, macro/trigger edits, and refund actions are prohibited in v1. Public replies and internal notes are never flattened into one visibility class, and instruction-shaped customer text is quarantined as data under Herald Security Law #1. C0 ships on synthetic fixtures only — no live instance, no credential, nothing sent.
